shared_elements: human figure(s) in profile in low relief
hand with articulated fingers grasping a vessel/cup
long garment with patterned, textured infill (hatching, scale/net-like fabric)
rosette/floral disc motif (A) alongside dotted-disc borders
justification: Both surfaces depict profile human figures in shallow relief wearing long garments whose surfaces are filled with dense hatched/net patterning and fringed borders, and in both a carefully rendered hand with separated fingers grips a small vessel or cup — a specific and conventional correspondence, reinforced by shared use of dotted rosette/disc ornament and staff-like verticals. The main difference is that A is a close fragment dominated by a band of wedge-like signs written across the figures and large rosettes, while B shows a complete narrative group of a seated figure raising a bowl on a throne with footstool, attended by a standing figure — a scene absent from what survives in A.
